text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocytes, basophils, ferritin, and chloride. There is also mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂), but renal and liver function are preserved. The elevated ferritin and CRP suggest inflammation. The hematologic findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infection. Close clinical correlation is recommended, especially for hypoxemia and cytopenias.
